title: Checks that parse forge output use a recorded real sample
goal: Tests of red-pipeline and the query-log revert parse at least one recorded real GitLab.com job log (timestamps and stream markers kept, secrets and hosts replaced by placeholders) under _tools/fixtures/, and kb/_self/backlog.md's definition of done asks for a recorded real sample when a check parses a tool's or forge's output. Failure it answers: SP-liemltg2's fingerprint tests passed on synthetic logs while every real kb-tests-windows log gave one fingerprint (BG-jam2lysj).
